name: getProvince
description:
Get provinces (search + show all with paging)
Description: Searches provinces by code or name (supports partial name match and returns all matching rows). Also supports listing provinces using “Show All” with pagination (returns up to 40 per call and provides the next page number when more results exist).
Use partial match when the user gives a keyword (like “southern”, “north”, “island”)
Use exact match only when the user gives the full province name or an exact code
If multiple matches are found, list them and ask the user to pick one

args.name: provinceCode
args.description: Province code to search (e.g., "000085"). Exact match.

args.name: provinceName
args.description: Province name to search (e.g., "Sabarag"). Partial match, case-insensitive.

args.name: returnAll
args.description: If set to something like "yes", "true", "all", "list", "available", "existing", etc., the transformer will return a paginated list of provinces (40 per call).

args.name: pageToken
args.description: Internal paging token returned by the previous call (Option B). If provided, the transformer fetches the next page of 40 from the grid.

args.name: pageSize
args.description: (optional, fixed internally to 40 to meet requirement)

args.name: matchType
args.description:
"partial" default for name

"exact" for code (and optionally name if needed)
